description: At the Northport Village board of trustees meeting this past Tuesday, September 20, Trustee Dave Weber initiated a walk-on resolution that would, if approved, allow Copenhagen Bakery to continue outdoor music for the next six Saturdays, from 10am-2:30pm. The bakery was given a Village code violation last month, after a resident’s complaints prompted Village officials to stop the outdoor performances.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Dave Weber
title: Trustee’s attempt to restore outdoor music at Copenhagen Bakery rejected at Village board meeting - Trustee Dave Weber Jr.
